items.title: Why Colgate-Palmolive Remains an Overlooked Dividend King
items.summary: Colgate-Palmolive Company (NYSE:CL) is often overlooked when investors discuss established dividend stocks. It is a Dividend King, with 63 consecutive years of dividend increases and uninterrupted dividend payments […]
